question: Which of the following planets is INCORRECTLY paired with its Total number of moons?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mars - 4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Jupiter has overtaken Saturn as planet with most known moons in the Solar System.
 
• Astronomers have counted 12 previously unknown moons in orbit around Jupiter, bringing the known total to 92.
 
• Saturn with just 83 moons, is left behind. (As of Feb 2023)
 
• The observations were led by astronomer Scott Sheppard of Carnegie Institution for Science.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Planets with Moons:**

 
 
• Mercury - 0
 
• Venus - 0
 
• Earth - 1
 
• Mars - 2
 
• Jupiter - 92
 
• Saturn - 83
 
• Uranus - 27
 
• Neptune - 14
 
 
 
• Jupiter:
 
 
• It is the largest planet in the Solar System.
 
• It takes around 11.8 Earth years to orbit the Sun.
 
• Jupiter has a strong magnetic field, 20,000 times stronger than Earth's.
 
• It is primarily composed of hydrogen and helium, with small amounts of methane, water, and ammonia.
 
• It's largest moon is Ganymede, which is also the largest moon in our Solar System.
 
 

Note: As of 15 May 2023, With total count of 145 Saturn has regained it's crown of maximum number of moons.
